documents.title: ISSprOM 2019-2 — sprint map and course display
documents.text: ISSprOM is used for sprint events in urban areas, parks and campuses. The participant map shows a start triangle, numbered control circles, straight leg lines and a double-circle finish; the straight lines do not prescribe the actual route travelled.

documents.title: Control feature precision
documents.text: A control must correspond to an identifiable, precise feature and position rather than a broad area. Entrances, junctions, bends and distinct man-made objects are usually easier to describe than vague areas.

documents.title: Beginner course design
documents.text: Beginner training should use prominent features and clear linear features so that difficulty comes from basic navigation rather than deeply hidden or ambiguously described controls.

documents.title: Route-choice training
documents.text: Route-choice training should preserve multiple feasible options between controls. The system may calculate a reference shortest path for verification, but it should not reveal that answer to participants before training.

documents.title: OSM is a candidate source, not proof of access
documents.text: A mapped line does not prove that a path is open, connected or safe in the field. A path without field verification may be used only for prototype calculations and cannot be released as a real training route.

documents.title: MVP distance evaluation rule
documents.text: Use path-network distance rather than straight-line distance between controls. The generated route must be within ±10% of the requested total distance.

documents.title: Project spacing rule
documents.text: Controls must not be too close together. The prototype uses an explicit minimum straight-line spacing for each difficulty and records each check as pass or fail.

documents.title: Unsafe feature exclusion
documents.text: Construction, prohibited access, deep water, uncrossable obstacles and unconfirmed controls in children's activity areas must be excluded or trigger human review.
